definitions.name: Study tools: daily engaged users
definitions.description: Unique people with a successful note save, highlight edit, or calculation. Opens and formatting alone do not count. New instrumentation; last 30 days, UTC.
definitions.sql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS day, properties.tool AS tool, uniq(person_id) AS users
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND properties.$host IN ('learnterms.com', 'www.learnterms.com')
  AND properties.telemetry_version = 1
  AND event = 'study_tool_used'
  AND properties.outcome = 'success'
  AND properties.action IN ('created', 'updated', 'cleared', 'highlight_changed', 'calculate')
GROUP BY day, tool
ORDER BY day

definitions.name: Study tools: usage by page and action
definitions.description: Distinct users and action counts by tool and surface. Autosaved notes can produce multiple actions; use unique users for adoption.
definitions.sql:
SELECT properties.tool AS tool, properties.surface AS surface, properties.action AS action,
  properties.outcome AS outcome, uniq(person_id) AS users, count() AS actions
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND properties.$host IN ('learnterms.com', 'www.learnterms.com')
  AND properties.telemetry_version = 1
  AND event = 'study_tool_used'
GROUP BY tool, surface, action, outcome
ORDER BY users DESC, actions DESC
LIMIT 100

definitions.name: Study tools: questions using tools
definitions.description: Question, module, and class IDs share the question_answered naming convention. Successful note saves, highlight edits, and calculations. Up to 100 questions in the last 30 days.
definitions.sql:
SELECT properties.questionId AS question, properties.moduleId AS module, properties.classId AS class,
  properties.tool AS tool, uniq(person_id) AS users, count() AS actions
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND properties.$host IN ('learnterms.com', 'www.learnterms.com')
  AND properties.telemetry_version = 1
  AND event = 'study_tool_used'
  AND properties.questionId IS NOT NULL
  AND properties.outcome = 'success'
  AND properties.action IN ('created', 'updated', 'cleared', 'highlight_changed', 'calculate')
GROUP BY question, module, class, tool
ORDER BY users DESC, actions DESC
LIMIT 100

definitions.name: Calculator: input methods and formulas
definitions.description: Successful calculations by typed/keypad/mixed/formula/history input, formula ID, angle mode, and surface. Settled live results count once per input revision; Enter does not count them twice.
definitions.sql:
SELECT properties.surface AS surface, properties.input_method AS input_method,
  properties.formula_id AS formula, properties.angle_mode AS angle_mode,
  uniq(person_id) AS users, count() AS calculations
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND properties.$host IN ('learnterms.com', 'www.learnterms.com')
  AND properties.telemetry_version = 1
  AND event = 'study_tool_used'
  AND properties.tool = 'calculator'
  AND properties.action = 'calculate'
  AND properties.outcome = 'success'
GROUP BY surface, input_method, formula, angle_mode
ORDER BY users DESC, calculations DESC
LIMIT 100

definitions.name: Study tools: failures and conflicts
definitions.description: Client-observed save/load failures, note conflicts, explicit invalid calculations, and worker timeouts. Offline saves may remain pending until reconnection; these are not server failure rates.
definitions.sql:
SELECT properties.tool AS tool, properties.action AS action, properties.outcome AS outcome,
  properties.surface AS surface, uniq(person_id) AS users, count() AS occurrences
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND properties.$host IN ('learnterms.com', 'www.learnterms.com')
  AND properties.telemetry_version = 1
  AND event = 'study_tool_used'
  AND properties.outcome IN ('error', 'conflict', 'invalid', 'timeout')
GROUP BY tool, action, outcome, surface
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 100

definitions.name: Study tools: opens and navigation
definitions.description: Notes/calculator opens, closes, and question changes while open. source=restore distinguishes restored panels. Highlight mode is tracked under mode_changed actions, not panel opens.
definitions.sql:
SELECT properties.tool AS tool, event, properties.surface AS surface, properties.source AS source,
  uniq(person_id) AS users, count() AS occurrences
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND properties.$host IN ('learnterms.com', 'www.learnterms.com')
  AND properties.telemetry_version = 1
  AND event IN ('study_tool_opened', 'study_tool_closed', 'study_tool_question_viewed')
GROUP BY tool, event, surface, source
ORDER BY users DESC, occurrences DESC
LIMIT 100
